decisions: DECISION_LOG A18 (2026-10-23) OQ-5 a: per instance Kruskal-Wallis, then pairwise Mann-Whitney U with Holm only after a significant omnibus test; across instances Friedman, then Wilcoxon signed-rank with Holm under the same rule; alpha 0.05; effect sizes A12, epsilon-squared, Kendall's W
DECISION_LOG A18 OQ-6 a: response = relative gap to the exact reference (%), per-instance median as the Friedman unit
DECISION_LOG A18 OQ-8 a: TSP-only family for the cross-instance test
DECISION_LOG A18 OQ-9 a: paper mode records a failed run, continues, excludes the cell from inference and reports it
DECISION_LOG A18 OQ-15 a: descriptive columns n, median, IQR, min, max, mean and sample SD (n-1)

DECISION_LOG A18 owner answers to the D-09 review questions: IQR with Q1/Q3 by linear interpolation (Hyndman-Fan type 7); effect size A12 for the per-instance Mann-Whitney U post-hoc and matched-pairs rank-biserial correlation for the across-instance Wilcoxon post-hoc; OQ-15 columns/variables/counts reading confirmed

DECISION_LOG A18 owner decisions on the D-05 statistics conventions: Mann-Whitney U method auto with continuity correction; Wilcoxon signed-rank method auto, no continuity correction, zero differences by Pratt; the method actually used is reported per pair; significance is p <= alpha everywhere; Holm within each comparison cell (no correction across instances); Friedman primary p-value = Iman-Davenport F (Demsar 2006) with the chi-square reported beside it; an all-zero Wilcoxon pair is reported with p = 1 and stays in the Holm family; an omnibus over identical values is undefined, not significant; power declared in advance

power_declaration.statement: Declared in advance: with 4 instances the pairwise cross-instance Wilcoxon signed-rank test after Holm cannot reach significance at alpha (the smallest possible adjusted p-value is above alpha), so pairwise evidence comes from the per-instance Mann-Whitney U tests over the replicates and the cross-instance evidence from the Friedman test with Kendall's W; there is no correction across instances, and no instance is added after results are seen.
